LESSON: REARING SMALL DOMESTIC ANIMALS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: FOOD PRODUCTION PROCESSES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested
Topic 2.1: Rearing Small Domestic Animals

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Rearing Small Domestic Animals. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Rearing Small Domestic Animals
2. Practise Rearing Small Domestic Animals at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Rearing Small Domestic Animals

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Rearing Small Domestic Animals
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Rearing Small Domestic Animals. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Rearing Small Domestic Animals at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Rearing Small Domestic Animals at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Rearing Small Domestic Animals
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Rearing Small Domestic Animals. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Rearing Small Domestic Animals using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Rearing Small Domestic Animals in the examples.
2. Explain Rearing Small Domestic Animals to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Rearing Small Domestic Animals using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Rearing Small Domestic Animals important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Rearing Small Domestic Animals
2. Practise Rearing Small Domestic Animals at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Rearing Small Domestic Animals

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
